_what: THE WORLD OF BLUEFIN -- the chapter that replaces act II's front in the YouTube release: 2001: A Space Odyssey's Dawn of Man sequence (Warner Classics upload 5NShEY1ScSY) from the fade up at 86.0 s to the last frame of the sun-over-the-monolith shot at 679.2333 s, then the Nightwish Darwin clip (renders/efmb-front.mkv 4.0 -> 70.4667, clean), hard cut, each part keeping its own audio, no mix. The rest of Endless Forms Most Beautiful becomes a standalone. Builder: scripts/build_world_of_bluefin.py (frame-exact chunks, one farm Workflow each, stream-copy join).
_version: 1 -- 2026-09-25: no in-video title slide (owner: 'don't make it in the video make it a thumbnail'); the source's THE DAWN OF MAN card is covered by a black box carrying A World before Kubernetes
